title: RRB ALP and Technician: keep the cycles, grades and practice separate
description: Avoid mixing ALP with Technician keys, use the correct grade’s response sheet and build distinct preparation blocks for each technical path.
intro: Our portal groups ALP and Technician resources together, but the recruitments remain separate. Technician CEN 02/2026 has Grade I Signal and Grade III key notices; ALP CEN 01/2026 is another recruitment. A familiar Railway logo does not make one candidate link suitable for both.

sections.title: Use a three-part label on every saved document
sections.body:
Record recruitment name, CEN number/year and grade or stage. “Technician key” is incomplete without the grade. The official Grade I Signal and Grade III notices use separate candidate links, although they publish the same October viewing window.

Open the [Technician key update](/exam-updates/rrb-technician-2026-answer-key-response-sheet/) and select the matching grade. Save the response sheet while the official window permits access. A candidate applying only for ALP should not use a Technician score or cutoff to judge their own recruitment. Keep older ALP stage notices in another folder too.

sections.title: Read the key and challenge process carefully
sections.body:
The published Technician window closes on 22 October 2026 at 23:55; check for any later official extension before acting after that time. The notice sets ₹50 plus applicable bank charges per question. Read the refund conditions for accepted objections in the notice.

List question ID, recorded response, provisional key and your reason before submitting. For a technical question, verify the operating condition, unit and convention; a formula used under the wrong condition is poor evidence. A provisional raw score is neither the normalised result nor a final selection forecast.

sections.title: Make separate revision blocks for your actual recruitment
sections.body:
For ALP, check the current CEN for the sequence of written, trade and aptitude requirements. For Technician, use the grade-specific syllabus. Shared arithmetic or reasoning practice can help both, but it does not replace the technical content or additional tasks named for your post.

Use a concept notebook with units, symbols and one worked example per technical idea. In general maths, practise rates and conversions. In science, explain what a law assumes before inserting numbers. After a mock, review a technical mistake and a general-subject mistake separately so the easier shared topics do not consume the entire session.

sections.title: Check post parameters before preferences
sections.body:
Read qualification, medical standard and vacancy changes for the exact post category. The October Technician vacancy-enhancement notice affects specified categories and boards; it is not a new combined ALP-plus-Technician vacancy total. Retain the corrigendum with the original notice.

Use the [ALP/Technician hub](/exams/rrb-alp/) for the source links and [process page](/exams/rrb-alp/admit-card/) for release steps. Prefer official candidate links reached from the board. Avoid sharing passwords or identity details with unofficial key-download services.

drills.prompt: Convert 72 km/h to metres per second.
drills.explanation: Multiply by 5/18: 72 × 5/18 = 20. The conversion follows from 1 km = 1000 m and 1 hour = 3600 s.

drills.prompt: Your application says ALP CEN 01/2026. Does a Technician Grade III CEN 02/2026 key determine your score?
drills.explanation: Recruitment, CEN and grade/stage must match the saved application. Shared portal coverage does not merge the selection processes.

checklist: Label my recruitment, CEN and grade/stage.
Use only the matching response-sheet link.
Check the objection deadline and evidence.
Read post-specific medical and vacancy parameters.

faqs.q: Are ALP and Technician one selection process?
faqs.a: No. They have different CENs, post requirements and stage rules.

faqs.q: Can a response-sheet score certify a final result?
faqs.a: No. Use the board’s final key, normalised result and published shortlist for the matching stage.
